items.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025
items.q: the guy that was coming in was a friend of mine, his name was Hector El Grade, who has passed now. And we called him Bucky.

ctx.x: Yeah. Overdub. So I overdubbed the guiro and then I overdubbed the maracas. And I went like, “I want to do this.” I love this. Yeah. That was my first experience man with Azuquita. But, so here’s the next thing though, so I had seen the recording studio. Now I’m going man, I hope somebody calls me for a session. You’re networking, “Here’s my number, man” you know blah-blah-blah. And I got a call, unfortunately I don’t remember who these guys were, but I got a call, it was for a TV show. It wasn’t a good…

that session?” He goes, “Yeah, yeah they just wanted this thing and you’ve just got to play simpler man.” He told me, “Man, this is not Cuban music. They didn’t want that. They wanted –” I went, “Oh.” So I just focus in and do it.
